title: Karaoke Studio v2.0.8
changelog: Crash Prevention & System Resilience: Added global UncaughtExceptionHandler, WebView crash protection (onRenderProcessGone), and safe orientation per device flavor
Hardware Audio & Melody Safety: Release active MediaPlayer before re-initialization to eliminate native EAS synth conflicts and SIGSEGV aborts
Safe MIDI Parser: Protected chunk bounds and added full exception guard to prevent infinite loops and MIDI corruption
API Compatibility: Replaced getContentLengthLong and windowLightStatusBar for 100% crash-free execution on all Android API levels (21+)
Lag-Free Skia Text Shadows: Replaced heavy chained GPU drop-shadow filters with hardware-accelerated Skia text-shadow
Remote Network Stability: Replaced aggressive startup network scan with on-demand IP modal and gentle subnet discovery
